title: Voidered Blaqua
description: A Fabric modpack from BlazeAqua that is guaranteed to give you a fun time with a plethora of client-side customization mods!
body:
Enjoy the marvels of the overworld...in a modpack curated by Blaze Aqua. This is the latest modpack I have ever published, but not the first I have ever made, and I hope you like it!

- Explore the new biomes and changes to Trial Chambers in the Overworld (don't get too cocky)!
- Craft new maces and Emerald, Copper, or Amethyst gear (really putting those mining trips to good use)!
- Make a new portal to access the Aether and make a backpack to store all of your Aether valuables (you will need it for all the loot you find)!
- Light up the Ancient City's Portal to discover the truth about the Warden!
- Get around with Waystones and horses that can be equipped with Netherite Horse Armor (before Mounts of Mayhem)!
